/**
 * @name Command injection via subprocess
 * @description Using subprocess with untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-packaging
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Subprocess or OS command execution that may be vulnerable to injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection through subprocess calls with unsanitized input

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Potentially vulnerable regular expression
 * @description Regular expressions with nested quantifiers or alternations can cause exponential backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos-packaging
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Expr pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "fullmatch"]).getACall() and
    pattern = call.getArg(0).asExpr()
  ) and
  exists(StrConst str | str = pattern |
    // Look for nested quantifiers or alternations that could cause backtracking
    str.getText().regexpMatch(".*[\\(\\[].*(\\+|\\*|\\{[0-9,]+\\}).*[\\)\\]].*[\\+\\*\\{].*") or
    str.getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\+|\\*).*\\|.*(\\+|\\*).*") or
    str.getText().regexpMatch(".*(\\(.*\\))(\\+|\\*|\\{[0-9,]+\\}).*(\\(.*\\))(\\+|\\*|\\{[0-9,]+\\}).*")
  )
select call, "Regular expression pattern that may be vulnerable to ReDoS: " + pattern.toString()
findings.hypothesis: Regular expressions with exponential backtracking that could lead to ReDoS attacks

/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description File operations using unsanitized paths could allow path traversal
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/path-traversal-packaging
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["join", "exists", "isdir", "isfile"]).getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall()
  ) and
  // Exclude test files and safe constants
  not call.getLocation().getFile().getBaseName().matches("%test%")
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file operations
